note: Synthetic data. Two planning costs for the failure prediction work, worked out from Fjordvik's own synthetic tables times published rates. They are not real-world costs.

wasted_visit.formula: labour cost per hour x (round-trip travel hours + on-site hours) + van running cost per km x round-trip road km, for each pump, averaged over the fleet

working.distance: straight-line km from the base of the nearest qualified technician to the pump, from dim_technician and dim_asset; road km = straight-line km x the road-distance factor; travel hours = road km / travel speed
working.on_site_hours_from: mean labour_hours of the Inspection events in fact_service_event

missed_failure.formula: (ratio - 1) x planned repair cost, averaged over the Failure events; planned repair cost = labour_hours x labour cost per hour + the list price of parts_used

left_out.reason: no published figure was found for either

price_basis: Labour at 2026 cost, the van at 2026 prices, parts at Fjordvik's 2023 list price.

fjordvik_planning_inputs.set_by: Fjordvik's own planning inputs, not published figures

labour_cost_eur_per_hour.unit: euros per hour worked, cost to the employer, 2026

sources.description: Published labour cost index, manufacturing, first half 2026

labour_cost_eur_per_hour.note: Central figure. The 2025 labour cost per hour in manufacturing, moved to 2026 with the labour cost index and scaled by how an occupation group's hourly earnings compare with all occupations. The central figure is the midpoint of two occupation groups (craft and related trades workers; technicians and associate professionals). The midpoint is worked out from the published figures; it is not itself a published value.

sources.description: Published transport appraisal unit values, Finland, 2022 prices
Published consumer price index, transport running costs

van_running_cost_eur_per_km.note: A van's running cost including taxes, without value added tax, insurance or capital cost, moved from 2022 prices to 2026 with the price index. A Finnish figure, used here for all four countries.

unplanned_to_planned_cost_ratio.unit: ratio of the cost of unplanned maintenance to planned maintenance

sources.description: Published federal maintenance guidance, programme cost per horsepower, 2010
Published utility case study, wastewater lift pumps, 2007

unplanned_to_planned_cost_ratio.note: The spread of the published ratios: reactive against preventive (low), against predictive (central) and against reliability centred maintenance (high). They are programme costs per horsepower a year, not costs per event, and they cover the repair only, not the owner's downtime.
